goal.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: Lumo mobile Home Ask Lumo full-bleed illustration, panoramic1774x887,2:1.
Edit target: the supplied flat cartoon campus image. Preserve its exact bold simple cartoon family, Ghanaian student friends, laptop, large held phone and lime intelligence circle, but RECOMPOSE THE ENTIRE CANVAS AS ONE IMMERSIVE FULL-BLEED SCENE.
Primary change: Remove the blank left panel entirely. Extend the Legon Balme Library building, steps, palms and campus landscaping continuously across the FULL WIDTH, right to every edge. Left and lower-left must show substantial visible campus scenery (steps/walkway/landscaping) rather than empty paper or blank sky. No vertical border, no split-panel appearance, no negative-space rectangle, no inset image, no collage, no uniform empty left half.
Composition: Characters remain grouped on the RIGHT side, at a slightly more modest size so the campus setting can span behind them. They discuss a savings goal with laptop and phone. Building can run across midground behind them. Keep the left/lower-left foreground scenery visually simple so a live HTML white question can overlay it later under a soft dark transparent gradient. DO NOT add a gradient or panel yourself: draw an actual scene edge-to-edge. Camera frames a full scene, not a cutout.
Style: Same cartoon style exactly: bold black outlines, dot-and-line eyes and expressive simple features, graphic pure black/white/neutral gray, flat planar shapes. No realism, texture, engraving,3D,photorealistic faces.
Accent: Only one acid lime #d7ff3f CIRCLE ON THE PHONE with central black sparkle, clearly visible at mobile size. No other colored surfaces or objects, no lime background.
Text: None whatsoever. The app overlays actual question text. No speech bubble, no letters/numbers, no logos or watermark.
Constraints: Wide full-bleed composition2:1, no margins, preserve current student and style identities; continuous architecture and steps throughout whole image.
